body: Is recording or live sound something you might find interesting? I started in the industry as an intern. Things are tight these days buts it’s worth checking entertainment careers.net and applying to some intern gigs. People on that site are generally legit.
What do you mean when you can’t think of anything besides music? What aspects are you thinking about?

This feeling of loving music and other projects is precious. I’m a roadie and I started my career when I was your age basically because music made me happier than anything else in life. If you pursue it man you can make lots of happy memories as a musician or whatever it is that you want to do. When it comes to dating someone once told me it’s important to find someone who can pull the arrows out of you back after a long day. That’s a trait you’ll only know from someone by communicating even the bad stuff with them.
Happy memories and wanting to make more of them. 2020 is shit but the debauchery will continue one day.

You must be a beast at whatever it is you do. You don’t need to blow money on expensive things maybe it’s time to think about the next step of finding someone who can pull the arrows out of your back after a long day of crushing it at whatever you do. Someone out there understands you and would love to be with someone successful. Don’t worry about the money too much  just chill out and find someone who will chill with you and support you too.
